description: Turkish Central Bank (TCMB) daily exchange rates — pure LOOK, no API key and no account. Reads the bank's public keyless bulletin (today.xml) over HTTPS and parses it in a single pass: every currency with buying / selling / banknote rates, a per-unit rate helper and a convert() through TRY. Verified field-for-field (22 currencies) against a reference XML parser.
author: codlook
